title: The ET-SoC-1's DVFS loop, and the leakage it never switches off
description: David Kanter described how a mature chip regulates its own power: an activity-based estimator inside a DVFS loop, and cache arrays behind leakage-suppression transistors. Checked against the ET-SoC-1's firmware, its open RTL and the card itself: the loop measures power rather than estimating it, has no hysteresis and hunts; the sleep transistors exist but nothing drives them; and leakage is 36% of a busy card, not his 5-30%.
